detail.longDescription: #AI #Propaganda For anyone who hasn’t already figured it out by now, these stupid news stories about AI breaching other computer systems security, this kind of “bad press,” is a carefully calculated PR stunt. They want people to believe that “we” (the “western world”) have to come up with the best AI technology or become vulnerable to our “enemies” (i.e. China and Russia). They want people to agree to spending more government money on military contracts for AI systems. This is how this “bad press” is profitable for companies like Anthropic or OpenAI. Yes, AI can breach secure systems if you really force it to Yes it can do it without much effort if the system was already pretty insecure to begin with. Yes, AI is very good and finding bugs and vulnerabilities in your code. But more government spending on AI is a horrible idea, don’t fall for this #bullshit . #tech #AI #LLMs #Anthropic #OpenAI #Claude #ClaudeCode #ChatGPT #GPT RE: https://defcon.social/@ai/117323276321059623
